details.title: Designing a Secure Signup System (OTP + Attempt Limits)
details.summary: A walkthrough of building a hardened FastAPI signup flow, covering OTP verification and attempt-limiting to close off common account-abuse gaps.

details.title: JWT in FastAPI, the Secure Way (Refresh Tokens Explained)
details.summary: How PyAuth issues short-lived JWTs alongside rotating, hashed refresh tokens, and why that pairing holds up better than long-lived tokens alone.

details.title: Building a Custom Analytics Tracker: Taking Back Control of Your Data
details.summary: The case for rolling your own lightweight analytics pipeline instead of an off-the-shelf tool, and what that buys you in ownership and flexibility.

details.title: JavaScript's Date is Broken. Here's Why Temporal is the Future.
details.summary: An introduction to the Temporal API and how it resolves long-standing pain points in JavaScript's built-in date and time handling.
